item.question: How does the chance-constrained epigraphic StQP compare to robust StQPs?
item.answer: The chance-constrained epigraphic StQP can be less conservative than robust StQPs, particularly when the confidence level for probabilistic optimality is not excessively high. This suggests that it may offer more flexibility and efficiency under certain conditions compared to traditional robust approaches.
